main_fit: each model selects ridge lambda from [0.01,0.1,1,10,100] on 2023 July-August validation dates
fixed_lambda_sensitivity: all six models use the A2-selected lambda within stock x venue x grid cell

fit_dates.train: 2023 January-June, fifth and fifteenth NYSE sessions
fit_dates.validation: 2023 July-August, fifth and fifteenth NYSE sessions
fit_dates.historical_exploratory_test: 2023 September-December, fifth and fifteenth NYSE sessions
fit_dates.external_test: 2024 January-December, fifth and fifteenth NYSE sessions; amended by user from 12 to 24 dates

external_freeze: 2023 feature order, medians, means, scales, lambda, coefficients and intercept are persisted before 2024 scoring; 2024 does not refit, calibrate or update them
inference: 2,000 synchronized whole-date bootstrap draws shared across stocks, models, venues and grids; leave-one-date-out on every actual external date
estimand_limit: G is conditional out-of-sample squared-error improvement, not a structural information share or causal effect
